in_hebrew.name: תמית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'tmh', meaning 'to pour out'. Tammim was a name given to a child born on a significant day.

in_greek.name: Θαμυεις
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek root 'thamios', meaning 'fertile'. Thamyeis was a name given to a child born in a productive year.

in_latin.name: Tamara
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin root 'tamar', meaning 'palm tree'. Tamara was a name given to a child born in a grove of palm trees.
